GetCompute.name: GetCompute
GetCompute.documentation: GetCompute operation for retrieving the current status and details of a compute instance.

StartCompute.name: StartCompute
StartCompute.documentation: StartCompute operation for creating or starting compute for a user in a project. This is an idempotent operation that returns a presigned URL to establish an authenticated connection to LooseLeaf Auth Proxy Service (LLAPS).

StopCompute.name: StopCompute
StopCompute.documentation: StopCompute operation for stopping the compute environment. This deletes the underlying compute and detaches the persistent volume.
